applicable_rules: AGENTS §§1–5: current Human/durable authority; capability != authority; bounded scope; current durable truth; fail closed on material ambiguity; evidence-bound mutation.
Bootstrap BOOT-1 -> BOOT-2 -> BOOT-3. Use the current Work Order and VERIFIED access/current-state fixtures; rebuild as FRESH_CONTEXT after CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE.
Agent Interface §§1.0,1.3: physically isolated workspace (a branch alone is insufficient); DIRECT only if all eligibility conditions hold. Runtime change is not Maintenance Lane.
Agent Interface §§1.4,1.7–1.9: continue within authority, repair ordinary check/review failures, finish against pre-existing durable acceptance and required Review.
Change Lifecycle §§3–4: behavior change is at least L1. I classify this material canonical-state/currentness seam L2: Issue + ADR + branch + checks + PR + exact-head Review. No merge authority.
Durable Data Doctrine §§1–7: answer identity, semantics, provenance, immutability, derivation, retention and migration at the owner-local seam.
Durable Trace: checkpoint material decisions, implementation and verification with recoverable pointers; label local-only changes LOCAL_ONLY.
Constitution §§2–8: project autonomy, native facts and proportional verification.

Workspace initialization, public-entry checklist, diagrams/templates without triggers, and automatic history/control-plane reads.

native_capability_reuse.application: Reuse Work Order/Issue, PR review, exact refs and native dependency facts as engineering evidence. Events reconcile against their owned canonical source; event payload or duplicated registry gains no authority.
native_capability_reuse.limits: Policy sources do not prove specific event API behavior; none was researched or invented.

owner_local_design.placement: Keep reconciler/data contract in the source-owning project; global governance supplies minimal cross-project invariants.
proposed_design_not_new_global_rules: Treat event as trigger/evidence; resolve stable entity identity and reconcile material decision facts against current owned durable state.
Distinguish unknown/absent/not-applicable, source provenance, mutable projection versus historical evidence, and derivation invalidation.
Specify duplicate/stale/out-of-order behavior, concurrency/currentness guard, retry/recovery and reconciliation failure locally; prevent stale observations overwriting newer canonical truth.
Address affected retention/compatibility/migration; retain one canonical state/lifecycle track.
owner_local_design.reuse: Apply stage-aware reconnaissance. Established cores prefer pattern/knowledge reuse in existing seams; a new coupled runtime needs the five-part External Wheel Admission Gate.
owner_local_design.details: Keys, versions, transport, storage, ordering and acceptance belong to the project contract.

evidence.done: Meet Work Order acceptance with reproducible checks and required Review on the exact candidate head; provide durable implementation/evidence pointers and remaining risks. Delivery can stop at branch/PR boundary without merge.
evidence.current: Bind decision/review to current source/target refs and reconcile lifecycle/dependencies; reject drift. Accept VERIFIED fixture currentness; missing old handoff does not invalidate it.
evidence.production: No production evidence exists here. Tests, review, bootstrap and model agreement do not prove production readiness or authorize deployment; such claims need applicable deployed/runtime evidence and separate authority.

recovery.rationale: The current Work Order supplies necessary project contract/state and bounded authority; access/current state are VERIFIED. Rebuild from that durable source. Lost handoff/chat is not a blocker.
extra_required_gates: Bootstrap BOOT-3C requires fresh/takeover Architect durable bootstrap writeback before EXECUTION_ALLOWED; this is a real-execution gate, not a request for prohibited external writes during the benchmark.
Before choosing the material architecture direction, I require ARCH-0 or current revalidated same-scope reconnaissance; bounded scope/acceptance does not explicitly establish a frozen design.
Retain required Review and assess DIRECT eligibility; no merge/deploy/admin authority inferred.
